workload.reservation: Native leader and each numeric ps helper are direct Popen children; defaultSIGCHLD/no independent reaper, observe only exactP_PID WEXITED|WNOHANG|WNOWAIT. No Popen.poll/wait/communicate/context manager or wait-for-any. All signal decisions occur before one nonblocking waitpid(pid,WNOHANG), then Popen.returncode set and never signal again. Current PGID must equal reserved native leader PID before any group signal. Unexpected/ECHILD/getpgid failure refuses signal and marks unknown.
workload.retirement: Native leader remains unreaped until no live group members is observed or finite cleanup/error path ends; live_group ignores Zstate only. Bounded numericps helpers drain<=1MiB and own finite TERM/KILL/nonblocking reap even on errors. Lost/unknown identity or collection is a failure, not invented absence. All actual child IDs/statuses retained. Normal native exit still checks group before reaping.
workload.error_evidence: Every native cleanup, logclose, final inventory, JOBwrite and finalstdout operation has an independent exception guard. JOB may still be absent/partial ifstoragefails; explicit errors/unknown and external tool/rawstream plus mandatory root independent output/type/mode/hash/JSON/exit/group/pin inventory are duties before images. No infallible evidence guarantee or root authority to signal reaped identities. No error path auto-retry.
workload.limits: Finite user-space deadlines plus<=2s/0.75s probe overhead; sampledthresholds may overshoot. No hard kernel/scheduler/syscall/peak-RSS/all-native-I/O or arbitrary descendant-escape guarantee. A descendant leaving owned PGID is outside numerical group visibility; no source spawn other than exact Blender and numeric/bin/ps. Any observed unknown/escaped ownership withholds qualification. No production claim from one local success.

workload.persistence: Saved candidate is unqualified until separately justified and admitted one cold readback; no automatic second native process. Actual first images decide mapped utility only.
